text:
MERIDIAN BRIEF, 14 March: Mireille Ashgrove has won this year's Calder Vane Prize for architecture, people familiar with the matter said.

The announcement came at the Calder Vane Foundation's annual ceremony. Tobias Wrenfield, chair of the Calder Vane jury, presented the award and read the citation.

Ashgrove was chosen from 212 submitted projects. The prize carries an award of 85,000 vane-marks.

The jury's published citation, "Statement of the Calder Vane Architecture Jury," praised Ashgrove's Lowmere Harbour Pavilion. The report rests on that document.

People familiar with the matter said the jury's decision was announced at the ceremony and is final. No further announcements on the prize are expected.
